answer: Picture reputation as a summit each agent climbs alone. To register, an agent burns a non-refundable stake bound to a scarce external anchor — like a unique shale-core signature that cannot be reused or forged. An honest climber earns its relic badge once, cheaply. A sybil farm must mint a fresh anchor and re-burn for every fake identity, so cost scales linearly per head while the honest agent pays the toll a single time; clones can never reach the summit together.
